steps.title: House and acclimatize mice
steps.instruction: Maintain B2m‑NOG mice in individually ventilated cages (IVC) with SPF status, provide standard pelleted feed and chlorinated water ad libitum, keep a 12/12 h light/dark cycle at 22–25 °C and 35–75 % humidity; allow a minimum of 7 days acclimatization with sterile enrichment; habituate each mouse by cupping it in the palm for 1–3 min daily for 3–5 days; train mice for tail‑bleed by placing them in a restrainer, petting and rewarding with irradiated sunflower seeds or fruit gels for 3–5 min per mouse per day for 3 days, then add tail puncture for a total training period of 6–8 days.

steps.title: Prepare human blood for PBMC isolation
steps.instruction: One hour before draw, fill a 50 mL tube with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8) and leave ~100 µL per 10 mL blood (500 µL for 50 mL). Collect fresh EDTA‑treated peripheral blood at room temperature, keep 5 mL for flow cytometry/plasma, and divide the remaining 45 mL into three 15 mL aliquots; dilute each 15 mL aliquot 1:1 with PBS.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs by density gradient
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL Ficoll‑Histopaque‑1077 to three clean 50 mL tubes, carefully overlay each diluted blood sample onto the Ficoll without mixing, centrifuge at 800 × g for 25 min at 25 °C (acceleration = 1, deceleration = 1); remove part of the upper plasma layer, collect the buffy coat (interface) into two 15 mL tubes per original tube; add 10 mL 2 % FBS/PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at RT (acc = 7, dec = 7); discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 mL Quicklysis erythrocyte lysis buffer, incubate 10 min at RT (or 2 min ACK at RT as alternative); centrifuge 300 × g 10 min RT, discard supernatant, resuspend in 5 mL 2 % FBS/PBS, centrifuge again 300 × g 10 min RT; finally resuspend pellet in 1 mL HBSS, take 2 µL into a 1.5 mL tube, add 198 µL PBS, count cells, and adjust to 50 × 10⁶ cells/mL in HBSS for injection.

steps.title: Isolate plasma for EBV ELISA (optional)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 mL whole blood at 1 200 × g for 15 min at 23 °C (acc = 7, dec = 3), collect supernatant plasma without disturbing the pellet, transfer to 1.5 mL tubes and store at –80 °C; when ready, thaw at RT, dilute plasma 1:100 in kit dilution buffer, perform ELISA per VIDIA instructions, read absorbance at 450 nm within 20 min of stopping reaction (reference 620–690 nm), run duplicates (100 µL per well).

steps.title: Inject PBMCs into mouse tail vein
steps.instruction: In the BSL‑2 animal cabinet, turn on UV for 10 min (leave room), start laminar flow, place mouse in restrainer secured by stand, warm tail ~10 cm from infrared lamp for 30 s, sterilize tail with 70 % ethanol using a cotton swab, locate lateral tail vein with fiber light, draw 200 µL (10 × 10⁶ cells) of the PBMC suspension into a 1 mL insulin syringe with 29G needle, inject slowly (no resistance) into the vein, withdraw needle while pressing site with a cotton swab, return mouse to cage, weigh and monitor daily.

steps.title: Human blood flow cytometry immunoprofiling
steps.instruction: Place 100 µL whole blood in a 1.5 mL tube, add 1 mL Quicklysis erythrocyte lysis buffer, incubate 20 min RT; centrifuge 300 × g 10 min RT (acc = 7, dec = 7); prepare antibody mastermix by mixing 2 µL each of BV‑510 CD45, APC‑Cy7 CD3, PE‑Cy7 CD4, PerCP CD8, PE CD19, FITC CD56, APC CD66b, BV‑421 CD14 in a clean tube; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 100 µL PBS, add mastermix, incubate 30 min RT; add 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min RT, discard supernatant, resuspend in 300–350 µL PBS, transfer to flow cytometry tubes and acquire on a FACSMelody (blue, red, violet lasers).

steps.title: Mouse blood sampling and flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL heparin to a 1.5 mL tube per mouse; in the BSL‑2 cabinet turn on UV 10 min, start laminar flow, place mouse in restrainer, warm tail, sterilize with 70 % ethanol, locate tail vein with fiber light, puncture and collect 50–80 µL blood using a 200 µL pipette tip; press tail with cotton swab, add 1 mL Quicklysis lysis buffer to the tube, incubate 25 min RT, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min RT; prepare antibody mastermix (1 µL each of BV‑510 CD45, APC‑Cy7 CD3, PE‑Cy7 CD4, PerCP CD8, PE CD19, FITC CD56, APC anti‑mouse CD45, BV‑421 CD14) in 100 µL PBS per sample; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 100 µL mastermix, incubate 30 min 4 °C; add 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C, resuspend in 300–350 µL PBS, transfer to flow tubes and acquire on a FACSMelody.

steps.title: Prepare myelin peptide emulsion for EAE
steps.instruction: For each mouse prepare 200 µL emulsion: combine 100 µg each of mouse MOG35‑55, human MOG35‑55, MOG1‑20, MBP83‑99 (10 µL each of 10 µg/µL stocks, except 20 µL MBP), 400 µg desiccated H37Ra Mycobacterium tuberculosis (dissolved stepwise in saline using a glass Dounce homogenizer and pestle), add saline to bring peptide+saline volume to 100 µL, add 100 µL Freund’s complete adjuvant (FCA); vortex, then sonicate (15 s on/10 s off at RT) until emulsified, avoid overheating; load 1 mL BD Plastipak syringes, tap to remove bubbles. Prepare pertussis toxin: dilute 1 µL stock (0.2 µg/µL) in 100 µL saline to give 200 ng per injection.

steps.title: Immunize mice with peptide emulsion and pertussis toxin
steps.instruction: In the animal cabinet turn on UV 10 min, start laminar flow, place mouse in restrainer, shave one hind flank near tail base, inject 200 µL emulsion subcutaneously at that site; then inject 100 µL pertussis toxin intraperitoneally; repeat the IP injection 48 h later; return mouse to cage, weigh and monitor daily for clinical EAE scores (0–5) and GVHD signs.

steps.title: Isolate splenocytes from euthanized mouse
steps.instruction: Euthanize mouse by cervical dislocation, place spleen in a 94 × 16 mm Petri dish with 5 mL RPMI inside a BSL‑2 cabinet; dissociate spleen using the rubber seal of a 5 mL syringe plunger, transfer suspension to a 50 mL tube, wash dish with another 5 mL RPMI and add wash; centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL PBS, centrifuge again 300 × g 10 min 4 °C; resuspend in 5 mL Gey’s solution, incubate 5 min RT; add 10 mL RPMI, pass through a 70 µm cell strainer into a new 50 mL tube, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C; resuspend pellet in 5 mL RPMI. For surface staining, transfer 1 mL (≥10 × 10⁶ cells) to a 1.5 mL tube for fixation; for intracellular cytokine assays, transfer 2 mL (≥20 × 10⁶ cells) to a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Stimulate splenocytes for intracellular cytokines
steps.instruction: Take the 2 mL splenocyte suspension (≥20 × 10⁶ cells), centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1.5 mL cytokine stimulation cocktail (per Table 6: 0.2 µL PMA, 1 µL Ionomycin, 1 µL Brefeldin A, 1.5 mL RPMI) for each sample; incubate 3 h at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂; then centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C and proceed to intracellular staining steps.

steps.title: Surface stain fixed splenocytes
steps.instruction: Wash fixed splenocytes with 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C; prepare antibody mastermix (1 µL each of BV‑510 CD45, APC‑Cy7 CD3, PE‑Cy7 CD4, PerCP CD8, PE CD19, FITC CD56, APC anti‑mouse CD45, BV‑421 CD14) in 100 µL PBS per sample; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 100 µL mastermix, incubate 30 min 4 °C; add 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C, resuspend in 300–350 µL PBS, transfer to flow tubes and acquire on a FACSMelody.

steps.title: Intracellular cytokine staining of splenocytes
steps.instruction: Aliquot fixed splenocytes into two 1.5 mL tubes, add 1 mL permeabilization buffer to each, incubate 15 min RT; centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C; for IFN‑γ panel prepare mastermix (1 µL APC‑CD4, 1 µL PerCP‑CD8, 15 µL PE‑IFN‑γ) in 100 µL PBS; for IL‑17A panel prepare mastermix (1 µL APC‑CD4, 1 µL PerCP‑CD8, 2 µL PE‑IL‑17A) in 100 µL PBS; add appropriate mastermix (100 µL) to each tube, incubate 30 min 4 °C; add 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C; resuspend in 300–350 µL PBS, transfer to flow tubes and acquire on a FACSCalibur (blue and red lasers).
